answer: A burn registry beats most sybil filters by pricing identity in sunk capital. Each node posts a 50 token bond at signup, and the chain burns 2% of it every epoch the identity stays active. Ten fake agents therefore bleed 500 tokens monthly, while honest participants recoup theirs through clean grading. An old workshop runs on the same arithmetic: the ferrous lathe rusts if idle, the cedar stock costs rent per pallet, the marble saw sits on a leased floor. Capacity must pay or die. A farmer holding ten seats pays ten burns. Grading stays cheap for honest peers and ruinous for him.
